intro.heading: KRISHNENDU
intro.description: I am a full-stack developer exploring AI engineering, building practical products, and contributing to open source. With experience as an AI Intern at FlyRank AI and active open-source contributions across the developer community, I focus on building scalable web architectures, developer utilities, and AI-native applications.

fancySection.subtitle: Experience & Focus Areas
fancySection.content: My engineering approach is grounded in a simple philosophy: Build things that work. Understand the systems beneath the abstractions. Keep learning in public. From real-time messaging architectures in Whisper to AI-driven codebase intelligence in StackAtlas and developer utilities in DevMate, I focus on turning complex technical challenges into dependable software.
highlights: Full-Stack Web Architecture (React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB)
fancySection.contactNote: When I’m not coding, you’ll probably find me playing chess, gaming, exploring music, or challenging myself with problems that make me think differently. I genuinely enjoy problem-solving, whether it’s cracking a tricky algorithm, finding an unconventional solution, or thinking a few moves ahead on the chessboard. Always open to collaborating on ambitious open-source projects and engineering opportunities.
fancySection.shoutoutText: for driving engineering excellence, open-source collaboration, and community growth.
